Job Summary

This is a remote position.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI Software Engineer to build and deliver production-grade Agentic AI solutions across enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, APIs, cloud-native services, and modern application frameworks.

This role requires a highly adaptable engineer capable of working across multiple programming languages and technology stacks while translating business processes into scalable AI-enabled solutions.

Responsibilities
AI Solution Development
Design, develop, and deploy production-ready Agentic AI applications.
Build intelligent AI agents with:
Tool integrations
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Context management
Memory
Stateful conversations
Human approvals
Exception handling
Deliver enterprise AI assistants and AI-enabled applications.
Application Development
Build scalable backend services using:
FastAPI
Spring Boot
Node.js
Develop responsive frontend applications using:
React.js
Design reusable application components and shared services.
API Service Engineering
Develop secure RESTful APIs and microservices.
Build event-driven services and asynchronous workflows.
Design integrations between AI services, enterprise systems, and business applications.
Develop data transformation pipelines and service orchestration.
AI Platform Engineering
Build production-grade RAG pipelines.
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise applications.
Implement AI tracing, monitoring, and observability.
Develop scalable AI services with robust context handling and orchestration.
Software Engineering
Translate business processes into:
User stories
Technical designs
APIs
Interfaces
Acceptance criteria
Test scenarios
Build maintainable, scalable, and secure enterprise software.
Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
DevOps Deployment
Deploy AI applications using enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
Containerize applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Support production deployments and post-production monitoring.
Ensure application reliability, scalability, and performance.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, or Application Development.
Proven experience delivering production AI applications.
Hands-on experience with:
Large Language Models (LLMs)
AI Assistants
Agentic AI
Strong backend engineering experience.
Experience building enterprise APIs and distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of containerization and CI/CD practices.
Production ownership of AI-enabled applications.
